Goal: Look up the member whose member number is {{inputs.member_id}} and read their full name and the current balance of their Share Savings account.

Inputs (use these placeholders):
- {{inputs.member_id}}: 5-digit member number

Outputs to extract:
- member_name (string): Member's full name as shown on the detail screen
- savings_balance (decimal): Current balance of the Share Savings account
